description: Saves a view with a name and a filter. The filter uses the fields of search_mentions, such as keywords or keyword kinds, platforms, status, relevant, sentiments, intents, languages, author tags, follower range, replies, link hosts, automated and free text. A list matches any value, a `not` list matches none, and all conditions are joined by AND. anyOf adds OR with groups of such conditions, at least one of which must match. Nothing is stored ahead of time, so the view shows whatever matches when read.

description.description: The view's purpose, shown below its name.

filter.description: The view's filter. Empty means all mentions.

anyOf.description: Up to 10 OR'd groups (at least 1). A mention must meet every condition of some group, plus all other conditions, so the filter reads (other conditions) AND (group 1 OR group 2 ...). Groups take view filter fields (platforms, sentiments, intents, keywordKinds, the not lists and so on) but no nested anyOf.

items.description: A set of conditions that must all be true. It uses the same fields as a view filter, except anyOf.

automated.description: true keeps posts that look machine-made. false keeps the others.

excludeAuthors.description: Leaves out these authors, given as display names, handles or profile links.

groupIds.description: Limits to keywords from these groups (grp_...).

intents.description: Keeps mentions tagged with one of these intents or topics.

isReply.description: true keeps replies and comments. false keeps posts that are not replies.

keywordIds.description: Keeps matches of these keywords only.

keywordKinds.description: Keyword kinds to keep, out of brand, competitor and topic.

kind.description: Only posts (post) or only comments (comment: replies, comments and answers). repository (GitHub repository events) is accepted and matches nothing, since Rumoro does not collect them. Omitted: all.

languages.description: Keeps posts in these languages only, as ISO 639-1 codes.

linkHosts.description: Keeps posts that link to one of these hosts or its subdomains.

maxFollowers.description: Keeps authors with this many followers or fewer. Unknown counts are left out.

minBookmarks.description: Keeps posts with this many bookmarks (saves) or more, counted when the post was collected. Posts without a bookmark count are left out.

minConfidence.description: Keeps mentions whose classifier confidence is this value or higher.

minFollowers.description: Keeps authors with this many followers or more. Unknown counts are left out.

minLikes.description: Keeps posts with this many likes (upvotes, reactions) or more, counted when the post was collected. Posts without a like count are left out.

minQuotes.description: Keeps posts with this many quotes or more, counted when the post was collected. Posts without a quote count are left out.

minRelevance.description: Minimum relevance score a mention needs.

minReplies.description: Keeps posts with this many replies (comments) or more, counted when the post was collected. Posts without a reply count are left out.

minReposts.description: Keeps posts with this many reposts (shares, retweets) or more, counted when the post was collected. Posts without a repost count are left out.

minViews.description: Keeps posts with this many views (plays) or more, counted when the post was collected. Posts without a view count are left out.

notGroupIds.description: Hides matches from keywords that belong to these groups.

notLanguages.description: Leaves out posts in these languages. Posts with an unknown language are kept.

notLinkHosts.description: Leaves out posts that link to these hosts.

items.description: The platform. Review platforms are appstore, googleplay, trustpilot and googlemaps (a place's Google reviews).

notRatings.description: Hides reviews with these star ratings. Other posts are not affected.

notSentiments.description: Hides these sentiments. Unscored mentions stay.

notTags.description: Leaves out authors with one of these tags.

platforms.description: Keeps posts from these platforms only.
